text.opengl: Add `struct Character`, `struct TextRenderer` and `InitTextRenderer` (load the text shader with a y-down projection of the window, sampler `text` on unit 0, a VAO and a dynamic VBO for one quad of 6 vertices × 4 floats), write the text shader, make the global `Text` in Init, and delete its VAO and VBO at the end.
text.vulkan: Add `struct TextConstants` (the text shader's colour), `struct Character` (with its place in the atlas), the atlas's size and `struct TextRenderer`, and the member `InitTextRenderer` (the text shader's pipeline for the window's render pass, the vertex buffer for 256 characters, mapped); write the text shader; set up the global `Text` in Init and destroy its buffer in `cleanup()`.
text.d3d12: Add `struct Character`, `struct TextRenderer` and `InitTextRenderer` (load the text shader, create the vertex buffer for the text's quads), write the text shader, make the global `Text` in Init, and release it in OnDestroy.

hint.opengl: `renderer.TextShader = LoadShader("text_2d.vs", "text_2d.fs", nullptr, "text"); SetMatrix4(renderer.TextShader, "projection", glm::ortho(0.0f, static_cast<float>(width), static_cast<float>(height), 0.0f), true);` and `glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, sizeof(float) * 6 * 4, NULL, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);`. Fragment shader: `vec4 sampled = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, texture(text, TexCoords).r); color = vec4(textColor, 1.0) * sampled;`.
hint.vulkan: `renderer.TextShader = LoadShader("shaders/text_2d.vert.spv", "shaders/text_2d.frag.spv", "text", VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, renderPass, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT);` and `createBuffer(sizeof(Vertex) * 6 * MAX_CHARACTERS, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT, …HOST_VISIBLE | HOST_COHERENT…)` + `vkMapMemory(…, &renderer.VBOMapped)`. Fragment shader: `vec4 sampled = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, texture(text, TexCoords).r); color = vec4(pc.textColor, 1.0) * sampled;`.
hint.d3d12: `renderer.TextShader = LoadShader(L"text_2d.hlsl", "text");` – the projection is the game's (b1). The vertex buffer: `MaxTextVertices * 4 * sizeof(float)` bytes in an upload heap, `Map` once into `renderer.pVertexDataBegin`, a view with stride `4 * sizeof(float)`. Pixel shader: `float4 sampled = float4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, text.Sample(wrapSampler, input.texCoord).r); return float4(textColor, 1.0f) * sampled;`.

hint.opengl: The text-rendering chapter's loop: `FT_Init_FreeType`, `FT_New_Face(ft, font.c_str(), 0, &face)`, `FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(face, 0, fontSize)`, `glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1)`, `FT_Load_Char(face, c, FT_LOAD_RENDER)`, `glTexImage2D(…, GL_RED, face->glyph->bitmap.width, face->glyph->bitmap.rows, 0, GL_RED, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, face->glyph->bitmap.buffer)`, `renderer.Characters.insert(std::pair<char, Character>(c, character));`.
hint.vulkan: The text-rendering chapter's loop: `FT_Init_FreeType`, `FT_New_Face(ft, font.c_str(), 0, &face)`, `FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(face, 0, fontSize)`, `FT_Load_Char(face, c, FT_LOAD_RENDER)`, `glm::ivec2 offset((c % 16) * ATLAS_CELL, (c / 16) * ATLAS_CELL);` and a memcpy per bitmap row (`pitch` bytes apart); `renderer.Characters.insert(std::pair<char, Character>(c, character));`; `createDescriptorSet(uniformBuffer, sizeof(UniformBufferObject), renderer.Atlas.View, textureSampler, renderer.Atlas.DescriptorSet);`.
hint.d3d12: The text rendering chapter's LoadGlyphs: `FT_Init_FreeType`, `FT_New_Face(ft, font.c_str(), 0, &face)`, `FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(face, 0, fontSize)`, `FT_Load_Char(face, c, FT_LOAD_RENDER)`, a `memcpy` per bitmap row into `atlas[(cellY + row) * AtlasWidth + cellX]`, `renderer.Characters.insert(std::pair<char, Character>(c, character));`; then the texture like `Generate` with `RowPitch = AtlasWidth` (1 byte per texel).

lives.text: Give the player 3 lives: losing the ball costs one; with none left the level is reset and the game goes back to the menu; ResetLevel gives the 3 lives back.

hint.opengl: `unsigned int Lives = 3;` in Game. In Update's loss check: `--game.Lives; if (game.Lives == 0) { ResetLevel(game); game.State = GAME_MENU; } ResetPlayer(game);` – ResetLevel no longer runs on every lost ball. `game.Lives = 3;` at the end of ResetLevel.
hint.vulkan: `unsigned int Lives = 3;` in Game. In Update's loss check: `--game.Lives; if (game.Lives == 0) { ResetLevel(game); game.State = GAME_MENU; } ResetPlayer(game);` – ResetLevel no longer runs on every lost ball. `game.Lives = 3;` at the end of ResetLevel.
hint.d3d12: `unsigned int Lives = 3;` in Game. In Update's loss check: `--game.Lives; if (game.Lives == 0) { ResetLevel(game); game.State = GAME_MENU; } ResetPlayer(game);`. `game.Lives = 3;` at the end of ResetLevel.

text.opengl: Write `RenderText`: for each character a quad of the glyph's size at its bearing, from the text's top-left corner (x, y), with the glyph's texture, the VBO updated with glBufferSubData; then advance x. Show `"Lives:"` and the number of lives at (5, 5) after the postprocessing quad.
text.vulkan: Write `RenderText`: bind the text pipeline, push the colour and bind the atlas; for each character write a quad of the glyph's size at its bearing, from the text's top-left corner (x, y), with the glyph's rectangle of the atlas, after the quads already written this frame, and draw it; then advance x. Show `"Lives:"` and the number of lives at (5, 5) after the postprocessing quad; in `recordCommandBuffer` give `Text` the command buffer and start its vertex count at 0.
text.d3d12: Write `RenderText`: for each character a quad of the glyph's size at its bearing, from the text's top-left corner (x, y), with its cell of the atlas, written into the vertex buffer; one draw for the line; then advance x. Start each frame's text at the vertex buffer's beginning. Show `"Lives:"` and the number of lives at (5, 5) after the postprocessing quad.

hint.opengl: `float xpos = x + ch.Bearing.x * scale; float ypos = y + (renderer.Characters['H'].Bearing.y - ch.Bearing.y) * scale;` – the six vertices from (xpos, ypos) to (xpos + w, ypos + h) with texcoords 0…1 (v = 0 at the top: the glyph bitmap's first row). `x += (ch.Advance >> 6) * scale;`. `RenderText(Text, "Lives:" + std::to_string(game.Lives), 5.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f);`.
hint.vulkan: `float xpos = x + ch.Bearing.x * scale; float ypos = y + (renderer.Characters['H'].Bearing.y - ch.Bearing.y) * scale;` – the six vertices from (xpos, ypos) to (xpos + w, ypos + h) with the atlas coordinates u0…u1, v0…v1 (v0 at the top: the bitmap's first row). `memcpy((char*) renderer.VBOMapped + renderer.vertexCount * sizeof(Vertex), vertices, sizeof(vertices)); vkCmdDraw(renderer.commandBuffer, 6, 1, renderer.vertexCount, 0); renderer.vertexCount += 6;` `RenderText(Text, "Lives:" + std::to_string(game.Lives), 5.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f);`.
hint.d3d12: `float xpos = x + ch.Bearing.x * scale; float ypos = y + (renderer.Characters['H'].Bearing.y - ch.Bearing.y) * scale;` – the six vertices from (xpos, ypos) to (xpos + w, ypos + h) with the cell's texture coordinates (`u0 = AtlasPos.x / AtlasWidth` …, v0 at the top). `memcpy(renderer.pVertexDataBegin + renderer.VertexCount * 4 * sizeof(float), vertices, sizeof(vertices)); renderer.VertexCount += 6;`. `Text.VertexCount = 0;` at the start of `Render(Game&)`.
